title: USP Discovery Registry
description: Discovery registry types for the optional dev.usp-protocol.discovery.registry capability. See specification Section 6.

RegistryLocation.title: RegistryLocation
RegistryLocation.description: Physical location for registry registration and search. Omitted for virtual-only businesses when no at_business_location or hybrid services are offered.

RegistrySearchLocation.title: RegistrySearchLocation
RegistrySearchLocation.description: Geographic filter for registry search: center point and radius in kilometers. Businesses or services with no coordinates (virtual/phone only) MUST be excluded when this filter is present; they SHOULD appear only when no geographic filter is applied.

radius_km.description: Search radius in kilometers (km). Distance is measured from coordinates.

RegistryContext.title: RegistryContext
RegistryContext.description: Optional localization and relevance hints for registry search. Aligns with UCP context (language, currency).

locale.description: IETF BCP 47 language tag (e.g., en-US). Influences result ranking and display language.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., USD). Display/ranking hint. When price_range is present without price_range.currency, this value is the resolved match currency. Registries MUST NOT convert prices via FX.

RegistryCategoryIds.title: RegistryCategoryIds
RegistryCategoryIds.description: Opaque category ID strings used by registry registration, search filters, and results. Values are IDs, not display labels. Matching is exact and case-sensitive. Every ID emitted in a RegistryEntry categories array or ServiceSearchResult category_ids array MUST be accepted by the corresponding categories filter and match that result when all other filters are unchanged.

RangeMatchMode.title: RangeMatchMode
RangeMatchMode.description: How a service interval S is compared to a filter interval F. Default when omitted: overlap. Modes: overlap = S intersects F (S ∩ F ≠ ∅); contained = S is wholly inside F (S ⊆ F); contains = S wholly covers F (S ⊇ F); equals = S and F are identical (S = F). Example duration: service offered 30–90 min, filter {min_minutes:60, max_minutes:60}: overlap=yes (60 is in 30–90), contained=no (30–90 is not ⊆ {60}), contains=yes (30–90 ⊇ {60}), equals=no. Example price: service $50–$150, filter {min:8000, max:10000} minor units: overlap=yes, contained=no, contains=yes, equals=no.

PriceRangeFilter.title: PriceRangeFilter
PriceRangeFilter.description: Filter services by price interval (minor currency units). Matching is within-currency only (no FX). Resolved match currency: price_range.currency if present, else context.currency; if neither is set, registries MUST reject with validation_error. pricing.model free is treated as amount 0. Build service interval S from fixed amount [a,a], published price_range, or [0,0] for free; exclude services with no indexable price interval when this filter is present. Compare S to filter F using match (default overlap). Example: service $50–$150 vs filter min=8000 max=10000: overlap and contains match; contained and equals do not.

min.description: Inclusive lower bound of F in minor currency units. Omitted = unbounded below.

max.description: Inclusive upper bound of F in minor currency units. Omitted = unbounded above.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code for min/max. REQUIRED when context.currency is absent (omitting both is ambiguous). When both are present and differ, price_range.currency is authoritative for matching.

match.description: Interval comparison mode. Default overlap. See RangeMatchMode for overlap/contained/contains/equals semantics and worked examples.

DurationRangeFilter.title: DurationRangeFilter
DurationRangeFilter.description: Filter services by duration interval in minutes. Build service interval S from fixed duration [d,d] or range [min,max] (ISO 8601 converted to minutes). Services with duration.undetermined true (or no indexable duration) MUST be excluded when this filter is present; they MAY appear when no duration filter is set. Compare S to filter F using match (default overlap). Example: service 30–90 min vs filter min_minutes=60 max_minutes=60: overlap=yes, contained=no, contains=yes, equals=no.

min_minutes.description: Inclusive lower bound of F in minutes. Omitted = unbounded below.

max_minutes.description: Inclusive upper bound of F in minutes. Omitted = unbounded above.

match.description: Interval comparison mode. Default overlap. See RangeMatchMode for overlap/contained/contains/equals semantics and worked examples.

RegistrationRequest.title: RegistrationRequest
RegistrationRequest.description: Request body for POST /registry/businesses and PUT /registry/businesses/{id}.

profile_url.description: URL of the business USP profile (/.well-known/usp) or UCP profile (/.well-known/ucp) depending on deployment_mode.

description.description: Optional brief description of the business for discovery display.

verticals.description: Service verticals offered by the business.

categories.description: Business category IDs published for exact-match search and returned unchanged in RegistryEntry for round-trip filtering.

location.description: Physical location. REQUIRED when the business offers at_business_location or hybrid channel services; MAY be omitted for virtual-only or phone-only businesses.

RegistryEntry.title: RegistryEntry
RegistryEntry.description: Stored business registration returned by the registry.

id.description: Opaque registration identifier assigned by the registry.

description.description: Optional brief description of the business.

categories.description: Business category IDs copied from registration. Every emitted ID MUST round-trip through BusinessSearchRequest categories and match this entry when other filters are unchanged.

created_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when the registration was created.

BusinessSearchRequest.title: BusinessSearchRequest
BusinessSearchRequest.description: Request body for POST /registry/search_business. At least one search filter MUST be present (not only pagination and/or context). Distinct filter fields combine with AND. See specification Section 6 filter matching semantics.

verticals.description: OR within field: match if the business offers any listed vertical.

categories.description: Category IDs, not display labels. OR within field: exact, case-sensitive match if RegistryEntry.categories contains any listed ID.

query.description: Free-text search across business names and categories.

deployment_mode.description: When omitted, search returns businesses in both deployment modes.

pagination.description: Cursor-based pagination. See USP specification Section 9.1.2.

DesiredServiceTimeMoment.title: DesiredServiceTimeMoment
DesiredServiceTimeMoment.description: Ranking preference for a specific instant. The first candidate start at or after at is represented.

at.description: RFC 3339 instant. Registry projects to the first grid tick at or after this instant.

DesiredServiceTimeRange.title: DesiredServiceTimeRange
DesiredServiceTimeRange.description: Bounded inclusive ranking preference from start through end (latest acceptable start, not occupancy end).

end.description: RFC 3339 upper bound inclusive for candidate starts.

DesiredServiceTimeFrom.title: DesiredServiceTimeFrom
DesiredServiceTimeFrom.description: Open-ended ranking preference from start through the bitmap horizon.

start.description: RFC 3339 instant. Every candidate start at or after this instant is represented, clipped to slot_count.

DesiredServiceTimePreference.description: One buyer time preference for availability ranking. Ranking context only; not a hard search filter.

RankSignals.title: RankSignals
RankSignals.description: Per-hit availability and relevance ingredients for service search ranking. Present on every hit of a response that applies availability ranking or that answers a request carrying time preferences, including hits with no hint or a summary-only hint. Values are registry-specific and comparable only within one response from one registry. null means unknown; 0 means known empty or known non-overlap.

relevance.description: Topical and geographic match apart from availability. Registry-specific scale within this response.

coverage.description: How much of the requested time has a hinted opening when desired_service_time_ranges is present. 0 means the requested time was represented in the structured snapshot and no opening overlapped it. null means not computed: no time preference, no usable structured hint, or requested time outside what the service published.

density.description: Fraction of represented candidate starts that are open, ignoring when openings fall. 0 means sampled and known empty. null means unknown because there is no usable structured hint.

soonness.description: How soon the earliest acceptable opening is relative to the request anchor and the registry's documented horizon. 0 means no acceptable opening inside the horizon. null means unknown because there is no usable structured hint. Populated even when prefer_sooner_availability_slots is false.

hint_usable.description: Whether availability_hint contributed usable structured ranking data for this hit. false means availability was unknown for ranking (omitted hint, summary-only hint, expired snapshot, malformed bitmap, or invariant failure) and is not a statement that the service is worse or unavailable.

ServiceSearchRequest.title: ServiceSearchRequest
ServiceSearchRequest.description: Request body for POST /registry/search_services. At least one search filter MUST be present (not only pagination and/or context). Distinct filter fields combine with AND. See specification Section 6 filter matching semantics.

verticals.description: OR within field: match if the service vertical is any listed value.

categories.description: Category IDs, not display labels. OR within field: exact, case-sensitive match if any listed ID is present in ServiceSearchResult.category_ids.

query.description: Free-text search across service names, descriptions, and categories.

desired_service_time_ranges.description: Optional buyer time preferences for availability ranking. Not a hard filter and does not satisfy the at-least-one-filter rule alone.

prefer_sooner_availability_slots.description: When true, earlier acceptable openings rank above later ones within the availability signal. When false, soonness is not applied by the registry default ordering.

pagination.description: Cursor-based pagination. See USP specification Section 9.1.2.

RegistryBusinessRef.title: RegistryBusinessRef
RegistryBusinessRef.description: Minimal business identity embedded in a service search result.

ServiceSearchResult.title: ServiceSearchResult
ServiceSearchResult.description: A single service hit from POST /registry/search_services. pricing aligns with the catalog Pricing model (Section 3.8). availability_hint aligns with the catalog AvailabilityHint type (Section 3.6) when indexed from the business catalog.

category.description: Flat category string projected from the catalog service's primary categories[] entry. Pick order: primary name, else primary value, else primary id, else the first entry's value, else the service type.

category_ids.description: Category IDs projected from indexed catalog categories[].id values. The array MAY be empty when the service has no category IDs. Every emitted ID MUST round-trip through ServiceSearchRequest categories and match this service when other filters are unchanged.

pricing.description: Pricing summary aligned with the service catalog Pricing type.

last_indexed_at.description: When the registry last indexed this service metadata from the business catalog. Optional but RECOMMENDED.

availability_hint.description: Approximate availability summary from the business catalog, when present at index time. Non-authoritative; platforms MUST NOT treat as a substitute for live availability queries (Section 3.6).

rank_signals.description: Availability and relevance ranking ingredients. Required on every hit of a response that applies availability ranking or that answers a request carrying desired_service_time_ranges or prefer_sooner_availability_slots; omitted only when the registry applied no availability ranking at all.
